note: Acceptance scenarios (Anthropic skill-creator convention; no standard runner yet).

evals.name: well-formed-page-passes
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page with full provenance frontmatter, layered input/output split, and a parse_status on every value-bearing artifact.

evals.name: value-without-source-pointer-fails
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page carrying a numeric value but no sources: pointer in frontmatter.

evals.name: fail-closed-citation
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page whose derived constant cites a source page whose frontmatter is missing or mismatched.
expect: fails closed (refuses) rather than shipping an unprovable value

evals.name: degenerate-identity-fails
evals.prompt: Run /check-page-shape on a page with a row whose identity tuple has a blank field.
expect: would otherwise let two distinct rows collapse and silently drop one
